hooks: Gold January se 21.43 percent gir chuka hai, pata tha?
topic.summary: A 12-minute illustrated documentary on the question of the Short "Gold price gira, Dhanteras par khareedna sahi?", which reached 1,928 people on Instagram. Go deeper than the Short: the mechanism, a worked example in rupees, the mistakes people make, what to check. Story so far: MCX gold has fallen 21.43% from its January record, settling at  ₹1,42,024 per 10 grams as inflation concerns, higher crude prices and investor selling weigh on precious metals. Experts say festive demand may offer support, but advise gradual buying and watching the  ₹1,40,000 support level.
topic.title: Gold price gira, Dhanteras par khareedna sahi?
